name: fuel-drum
notes: The red fuel drum by the wrecks, sheds and mast that chains when it goes up (roadmap P-43). The game's buildBarrel (index.html) as data: a 0.95 m drum, two rolling hoops, a yellow hazard band with a dark skull stencil, the filler cap and a bung on the lid. The paint and the band share a finish, and so do the hoops, cap and stencil, so it draws twice (P-43 wants one or two). The top joint is where the flames come out.

band.note: the paint's finish, so the two draw as one

top.note: the lid: flames and the blast start here

parts.name: hoop
parts.note: the rolling hoops, low and high

parts.name: skull
parts.note: the hazard stencil on the band, facing +Z
